items.title: Actuaries are Data Engineers
items.content_html:
Actuaries are Data Engineers

Whether you like it or not, if you're an actuary, you're probably a data engineer :material-database:.

You once let slip that you did a Udemy course on SQL and databases and now you've found yourself as the "one who pulls".

Don't fight it - I can show you how you go from sql scripts stored on your desktop to fully automated pipelines.
